# Interactive Chemistry

> > Interactive Chemistry provides game-based simulations and digital tools for learning chemistry concepts including ionic bonding, redox reactions, Lewis structures, and organic chemistry mechanisms.

The site features interactive educational games like Matchmaker (ionic bonding), Ketone Crush (organic functional groups), and ChemLEAP (molecular interactions sandbox). Tools include molecular model kits, reaction simulations, and games that teach electron transfer, combustion, photosynthesis, and nucleophilic substitution through hands-on digital experiences.

## Key Topics

- Ionic Bonding
- Lewis Dot Models
- Redox Reactions
- Electron Transfer
- Octet Rule
- Metal Reactivity
- Equation Balancing
- Polyatomic Ions
- Activation Energy
- Valence Bonds
- SN2 Reactions
- Combustion Reactions
- Molecular Model Kit
- Chemistry Simulations
- Educational Games

## Core Interactive Games

- [Matchmaker & PT Intro Page](https://interactivechemistry.org/IntroPageMatchmaker2024): Ionic bonding and Periodic Table game introduction page
- [Matchmaker (Ionic Bonding Game)](https://interactivechemistry.org/MatchmakerRJ): Ionic bonding game using interlocking shapes for cations and anions
- [ChemLEAP](https://interactivechemistry.org/ChemLEAP): Digital sandbox for molecular interactions and phase transitions
- [Ketone Crush Intro Page](https://interactivechemistry.org/IntroPageKetoneCrush): Organic chemistry game matching structures to functional groups

## Molecular Structure Tools

- [2-D Molecular Model Kit](https://interactivechemistry.org/Assignment10.3): Interactive tool for building Lewis Dot Models following Octet Rule

## Redox and Electron Transfer Simulations

- [Electron Transfer 2020](https://interactivechemistry.org/BattleRoyalNew): Redox reactions simulation using Activity Series and metal reactivity
- [Matchmaker with Electron Transfer](https://interactivechemistry.org/CuSO4B): Copper Sulfate redox reactions with metals using interlocking shapes
- [Reactions of Calcium Metal](https://interactivechemistry.org/CalciumReactions): Calcium redox reactions with water and hydrochloric acid simulation

## Reaction Simulations

- [Combustion Reactions](https://interactivechemistry.org/CombustionReactions): Combustion simulation with methane/propane using activation energy
- [Photosynthesis](https://interactivechemistry.org/Photosynthesis1): Photosynthesis simulation using Lewis Dot Models and energetics

## Organic Chemistry Games

- [SN2 Reaction Game](https://interactivechemistry.org/SN2): Nucleophilic substitution game with collision-based SN2 reactions

## Optional

- [Experiments and Prototypes](https://interactivechemistry.org/Experiments-Prototypes): Collection of experimental chemistry simulations and prototypes
